style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: water containers in yellow, orange and terracotta-brown (same world as Pour It): orange juice-family keys with dark ink, a watermelon-pink Enter as the treat, soft cream keys and a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.why: Phase 4 'a row of small cups waits beside a larger container' (tapping a small cup pours it into the larger jar or can and counts the cups): one small opaque cup standing upright, drawn once per cup in a box of its own aspect.
images.prompt: A single small handleless drinking cup moulded from solid opaque sunny-yellow matte plastic, slightly tapered with a smooth plain body, a thin rounded rim and a flat base, empty and standing upright.

images.object: tall opaque saffron-orange plastic water bottle with a screw cap
images.why: The water bottles of the capacity work (a bottle's labelled capacity compared with litres and millilitres, or poured into the jug or the larger container): one tall opaque bottle standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect; its labelled capacity, any water level, marks and numbers are drawn in code.
images.prompt: A single tall drinking-water bottle moulded from solid opaque saffron-orange plastic, with a smooth cylindrical body, a gently rounded shoulder, a narrow neck and a matching screw cap, the surface completely plain, unprinted and matte, standing upright.

images.object: clear glass water pitcher with one loop handle
images.why: The measuring jug(s) of phase 1 (labelled measuring jugs beside the water tank) and the row of empty litre jugs of phase 2: one tall clear glass jug standing upright, empty and see-through (its inside and handle opening are transparent), so the tool draws the light-blue water behind it and every mark, label and number on top in code.
images.prompt: A plain, empty classic clear glass water pitcher with thin transparent walls, crisp dark-grey edges and a few bright highlights: a gently rounded belly narrowing slightly to the neck, a flared pouring lip with a spout on the left and one looped glass handle on the right, completely smooth and unprinted, standing upright with no reflection beneath it.

images.object: bright yellow plastic household bucket, handle folded down
images.why: Phase 2 'a bucket marked in millilitres' (the bucket with a litre scale down its left edge and a millilitre scale down its right edge, its drops poured into the litre jugs): one wide opaque bucket standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect; the scales, marks and numbers are drawn in code beside it.
images.prompt: A single round household bucket of solid bright-yellow moulded plastic with a smooth tapering body, a thick rolled rim and a flat base, its black wire handle folded down flat against one side, standing upright.

images.object: brown plastic water storage tank, side view
images.why: Phase 1 'a water tank stands beside the one litre jug' (the big container the litres are taken from) and the larger container of phase 4 that the small cups fill: one large opaque terracotta-brown tank standing upright, drawn in a box of its own aspect; its labelled capacity and any water level are drawn in code.
images.prompt: A single large round plastic water storage drum in solid terracotta-brown moulded plastic with a wide screw lid on top and a small outlet at its base, standing upright.

images.object: clear glass storage jar, tall straight-sided cylinder, open mouth
images.why: The larger container of phase 3 (the jar with a litre scale and a millilitre scale) and phase 4 (the jar the small cups are poured into): one tall clear glass jar standing upright, empty and see-through (its inside is transparent, its sides straight), so the tool draws the water behind it with a level that rises in a straight line with the volume, and every mark, scale and number on top in code.
images.prompt: A plain, empty classic clear glass storage jar with thin transparent walls, crisp dark-grey edges and a few bright highlights: a tall cylinder with perfectly straight vertical sides, a wide open mouth with a plain flat rim and a thick clear glass base, completely smooth and unprinted, standing upright with no reflection beneath it.

images.why: Phase 4 'a 140 mL tea glass' and the nine small counter glasses poured into the larger jar or drum (tapping a small glass pours it in and counts the glasses): one plain clear glass tumbler standing upright, empty and see-through (its inside is transparent), so the tool draws the tea or water behind it in code, clipped to the glass's inner region.
images.prompt: A plain, empty, simple clear glass drinking tumbler with thin transparent walls, crisp dark-grey edges and a few bright highlights: slightly tapered with straight smooth sides, a thick clear glass base and a plain rim, no handle, completely smooth and unprinted, standing upright with no reflection beneath it.
